info.description:
The following endpoints are stateful in the Sandbox: * Retrieve Pensions Income * Create and Amend Pensions Income * Delete Pensions Income # Send fraud prevention data HMRC monitors transactions to help protect your customers' confidential data from criminals and fraudsters.
! Warning You are required by law to submit header data for this API. This includes all associated APIs and endpoints.
[Check the data you need to send](/guides/fraud-prevention/). You can also use the [Test API](/api-documentation/docs/api/service/txm-fph-validator-api/1.0) during initial development and as part of your quality assurance checks. # Mapping APIs to Self Assessment tax return forms Some parameters in this API map to box numbers in one or more Self Assessment tax return forms. To learn more and to download this mapping information as a CSV file, go to [income-tax-mtd-changelog/mapping](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog?tab=readme-ov-file#mapping-apis-to-self-assessment-tax-return-forms) on GitHub. # Changelog You can find the changelog in the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/#readme) on GitHub. # Support * Direct reports of bugs or errors in Production or Sandbox code, or queries about HMRC business functionality (such as how a specific field is used by HMRC or why it is needed) to the [Software Development Support Team (SDST)](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/developer/support). * Send queries or feedback related to the design of the APIs (including recommended changes) using the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/issues) GitHub page. * Is this page not working properly? (opens in new tab)

delete.description:
This endpoint allows the developer to delete foreign pensions and overseas pension contributions. 
A National Insurance number and tax year must be provided.

### Test data
Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.

| Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario                                                                                                                      |
| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates success response.                                                                                                   |
| NOT_FOUND                        | Simulates the scenario where no data is found.                                                                                |
| STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful delete.                                                                                                   |
| REQUEST_CANNOT_BE_FULFILLED      | Simulates the scenario where the request cannot be fulfilled for various reasons other than the ones triggering other errors. |
| OUTSIDE_AMENDMENT_WINDOW         | Simulates the scenario where request cannot be completed as it is outside the amendment window.                               |

The start year and end year must not span two tax years. The minimum tax year is 2021-22. No gaps are allowed, for example, 2020-22 is not valid.
(The minimum tax year in Sandbox is 2019-20.)

countryCode.description: A three-letter code that represents a country name. The value must in a ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 format.

amountBeforeTax.description: The total amount before any tax taken off pension. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxTakenOff.description: The amount of tax taken off pension. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

specialWithholdingTax.description: Special Withholding Tax (SWT) amount taken off this payment. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

foreignTaxCreditRelief.description: A boolean indicating whether Foreign Tax Credit Relief (FTCR) has been claimed.

taxableAmount.description: This is the amount that will be liable to income tax and forms part of the total taxable income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

items.description: Financial details about overseas pension contributions income

customerReference.description: A reference the user supplies to identify the record. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

exemptEmployersPensionContribs.description: The amount the employer contributes to the overseas pension scheme. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

migrantMemReliefQopsRefNo.description: The qualifying overseas pension scheme reference number for migrant member relief. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

dblTaxationRelief.description: The relief given as tax credit on the overseas earnings. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

dblTaxationCountryCode.description: A three-letter code that represents the double taxation country name. The value must be ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

dblTaxationArticle.description: The taxation article reference number. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

dblTaxationTreaty.description: The name of the treaty that has the right to collect tax. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

sf74reference.description: The SF74 reference number for transitional corresponding relief claims. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.
